title: Isotope Separation
description: Isotopes of one element are chemically the same; only their mass differs, by about one per cent for uranium. Spin them fast enough and that is enough to sort them, a little at a time. Unlocks the Gas Centrifuge Cascade, Yellowcake and Fluorspar.

puzzle.goal: In a spinning rotor a heavy and a light molecule of the same gas settle differently. Their molar masses differ by M, the wall moves at speed v and the gas is at temperature T. Write α, how much richer in the light one the gas at the axis is than at the wall.
puzzle.name: Centrifuge separation factor
puzzle.ask: Find α for uranium hexafluoride: M = @{M} kg/mol, v = @{v} m/s, R = 8.314 J/(mol·K), T = @{T} K.
puzzle.method: Each species follows the Boltzmann law in the rotating frame, n ∝ e^(mω²r²/2RT); divide the two at the wall and at the axis.
